summary.en: Single-sequence protein structure prediction with a large protein language model
summary.zh: 使用大型蛋白质语言模型进行单序列结构预测

description.en:
ESMFold predicts atomic-level protein structures directly from a single amino-acid sequence using representations learned by the ESM-2 protein language model. It avoids the multiple-sequence-alignment search used by many earlier high-accuracy pipelines, enabling much faster inference across very large sequence collections.

The accompanying work used this speed to explore hundreds of millions of metagenomic protein sequences and release the ESM Metagenomic Atlas.
description.zh:
ESMFold 使用 ESM-2 蛋白质语言模型学到的表示，直接从单条氨基酸序列预测原子级蛋白质结构。它不依赖许多早期高精度流程使用的多序列比对搜索，因此能够更快地处理超大规模序列集合。

相关工作利用这种速度探索数亿条宏基因组蛋白质序列，并发布 ESM Metagenomic Atlas。

place.en: Meta,New York University, Stanford University, MIT
place.zh: Meta、New York University、Stanford University、麻省理工学院
